topic: why a tea stall near the port still charges 10 taka a cup
goal: watch to the end and save the video for the next trip to Chattogram

audience.who: students and young travellers in Bangladesh aged 18 to 30
audience.wants: cheap places that are worth the trip
objections: 10 taka tea must taste like water
the price has probably gone up by now

facts_given: a cup of milk tea costs 10 taka
the owner, Karim, boils the milk for about 40 minutes before he pours the first cup
he sells about 600 cups a day
he has raised the price once, from 8 to 10 taka in 2022, when milk prices went up
